title: a case class that installs a lying Symbol.hasInstance must not capture a sibling's error in a match
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Error Prototype' (Locked): "Handler selection MUST use compiler-stable nominal identity, not a forgeable user `_tag` or minifier-sensitive constructor name in compiled artifacts." Its acceptance control is 04-nominal-errors/error-is-does-not-consult-a-user-installed-has-instance, which passes on both backends: `Error.prototype.is`/`.matches` were moved off bare `instanceof` on the fork on 2026-08-25, and `match` was the one dispatch site that still consulted it. Filing this red rather than not at all was the whole point — the two backends disagreed about which handler a program selects, and nothing else in the corpus could see it. RETIRED MARKER (go, 2026-08-25): the fork used to print `timeout` where the reference prints `notfound:k` — it compiled and ran this program clean and selected the WRONG handler, so nothing but an `output` case that reads what the program printed could report it. Its `lowerMatch` emitted a bare `error instanceof CaseClass` chain, and `instanceof` consults the RIGHT operand's `Symbol.hasInstance`, so `Timeout` captured a genuine `NotFound`. The marker also recorded the blocker that had to clear first, and it did clear in the same change: a native type predicate narrows its else branch by assignability, so two structurally identical Error classes exclude each other and a `matchPartial` fallback over such siblings collapses to `never` (TS2339, 'Property message does not exist on type never'). The fork now merges the reference's nominal brand beside each authored Error class AND emits its own `__smithersErrorIs` predicate in place of the operator, which is exactly the order the marker required. Measured XPASS on go by `node conformance/runner/run.mjs --backend both --jobs 4` (354 cases, exit 0, go 1 xpass / 10 xfail), and re-measured before retirement by `node conformance/runner/run.mjs --backend both --filter a-case-class-that-lies-about-instanceof --json`, which reports `stdout: ["notfound:k"]`, exit 0 and `agreement.agree: true` on BOTH backends. The residual the brand cannot close is pinned green beside this case as 04-nominal-errors/a-match-partial-fallback-over-two-subclasses-of-one-base-still-checks, and the three sibling forgeries one predicate fix had to close together are the lying-matchPartial, self-denying and lying-base cases in this area.
